notes.title: Fixed missing tutorial messages, tweaked resource collision on collection
notes.content: Fixed missing tutorial messages, tweaked resource collision on collection

notes.title: Fixed resource glitch
notes.content: Fixed a resource glitch causing you to get too many resources when harvesting them into your planet!

notes.title: You can now aim and fire with the mouse
notes.content:
Many players prefer aiming with the mouse. Now you can!

Fixed loading on a random map causing things to spawn twice. 
Fixed the enemy AI's debug screen showing.

notes.title: A few updates based on your feedback!
notes.content:
Your feedback counts! Here are some small changes made in response to your feedback:
- Player shots no longer damage ore
- Removed limit to planet ore collection
- Removed friendly fire
- Fixed shots sometimes going through targets at point blank range
- Added news window on main menu
